working_agreement: User authorized implementation of trace-commands, beginning with trace-cli, through validation, commits, pushes and a ready PR for review. Continue in-scope fixes without repeated confirmation. Ask before merging, publishing or paid provider calls.

criteria.a1: Offline workspace-scoped trace discovery and run selection without provider startup
criteria.a2: Deterministic escaped timeline with outcomes, relationships and completeness
criteria.a3: Safe explicit export and verifiable bundles through existing APIs
criteria.a4: Versioned sourced pricing with correct unknown and partial-cost semantics
criteria.a5: In-session trace and usage match offline inspection across foreground, summaries and retries
criteria.a6: Capture flag/settings/env precedence and sandbox forwarding
criteria.a7: Actionable failure trace hints preserve original errors and JSON output
criteria.a8: Operator shell journal lifecycle including denial, cancellation and capture failures
criteria.a9: Documented workflow, visibility alias migration and credential-free CLI acceptance
